[Section] Results ::: Performance (WER) analysis on evaluation data ::: Impact of role on WER
[source_id=40] Speaker's role seems to have an impact on WER: we obtain an average WER of 30.8% for the Anchor speakers and 42.23% for the Punctual speakers. This difference is statistically significant with a p-value smaller than $10^{-14}$ (med(A) = 21%; med(P) = 31%; U = 540,430; p-value < 0.001) .
